title: Depth grade now shades open water: deliberate?
question: Does the dark vertical band through the pond read right, or does open water want exempting from the depth grade?
context_md:
scene=rockdrop, first pan after the master merge.

The band is in **every tile, including before the slab lands**, so it is not the drop. It is master's TerrainLight::Depth (its default) shading everything below the frozen skyline. Its own comment says water inside the ground *takes the same grade on top, deliberate -- a flooded cave is deep first and wet second* -- but this is the first time that grade has met an **open pond** rather than a flooded cave.

It does not line up with the chunk grid (band spans world x 225-286; boundaries are at 192/256/320), so it is not the usual seam artifact.

Separately: filmstrip has no terrain_light argument, so this cannot be A/B'd headlessly. Say the word and I will add one.
